name: Locally Controlled Spot Noise
definition: A spatially controlled procedural noise that uses a non-uniform distribution of impulses convolved with a kernel composed of multiple ellipsoidal Gaussian functions to produce structured patterns in texture space.
summary: Locally Controlled Spot Noise is a procedural method generating structured patterns by convolving impulses with ellipsoidal Gaussians, distinguished by its ability to control impulse density and kernel orientation via underlying data fields.
